gen-gf-autour-one-gf-nokora: Nokora lays down a dark, sturdy band of lowercase, with an s that never pinches shut. And Autour One earns its keep in big, short lines, where its round letters get a clean run-in.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with a welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Autour One is the loud, unmodulated one; the body does the quiet talking.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans: Autour One draws every stroke at a single width, bold and expressive, with round letters entered through a clear channel. Noto Sans settles in beside it, lowercase filling its height.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Expressive and bold, Autour One keeps its stroke width constant from the first curve to the last. And Noto Sans Adlam holds its curve endings well apart, with s and z standing full.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: A clear channel leads into every round letter of Autour One, and its horizontals match its verticals in weight. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined handles the quieter job, with generous room between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Terminals point outward and the lowercase climbs nearly to cap height, so the body text reads modern and brisk. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs does the steady talking, while Autour One takes the bold, expressive lead.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Loud meets open: Autour One runs smooth where curves meet stems, while Noto Sans Arabic keeps its small letters wide and tall. Muscle up top, generosity underneath, nothing fussy in between.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Approachable at heart, Noto Sans Armenian gives its round letters wide, inviting openings under Autour One's constant-pressure strokes. And over pages of text, it keeps its tall, full c, s and z easy on the eye.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan looks modern, its curve tips never quite touching. Its pronounced x-height keeps text flowing smoothly line after line, while Autour One keeps its bold, hairline-free strokes up top.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Autour One looks drawn with a compass pencil, bold and expressive. Noto Sans Balinese settles in beside it, with breathing space inside each curve and short ascenders that stay low.
